meta.description: Arabic and English CV screening for small and medium companies in Egypt.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may have changed or the page was removed. Nothing in your account was deleted.

gallery.title: Design system
gallery.intro: The shared components every screen is built from, in their states. Hover, focus and press appear when you interact with them.
gallery.statesNote: States shown: default, disabled, loading and error.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.note: One primary button per screen. The destructive button is never filled, and a trailing ellipsis means a confirmation follows.

fields.title: Fields and selects
fields.note: Native controls, 36 px high. An error replaces the helper text, so the field keeps its height.
fields.jobTitleHelp: Candidates see it on their application status page.
fields.jobTitleLocked: The title can't change once the job is published.
fields.jobTitleChecking: Checking for a job with the same name…
fields.jobTitleMissing: A job title is needed to save the job.
fields.languageHelp: Used only for the Language part of the score.
fields.locationHelp: Suggested from the job description. Change it or save it as it is.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.note: The selected tab is marked by weight and an ink underline, not by amber.
tabs.label: Job sections

status.title: Status, confidence and decisions
status.note: Every indicator is a shape and a word, with color as a third, extra channel. A decision always names who made it.

dialog.title: Dialog
dialog.note: Focus opens on the safe choice, Escape closes it, and focus returns to the button that opened it.
dialog.heading: Discard your changes to this job?
dialog.body: The job goes back to its last saved version. Candidates and their scores are not affected.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.note: They state a fact and offer one action.
toasts.batchDone: 24 of 25 files are processed. One needs review.
toasts.rejected: Mohamed Abdallah was rejected. The decision is recorded in your name.
toasts.sendFailed: 3 messages couldn't be sent. Nothing was sent twice.

switcher.title: Language switch
switcher.note: Names the other language in its own script, and keeps the same page when switching.
